population: 全量（每项为整表/整目录聚合，无抽样）

fields.semantic: K 线可得时间（交易所发布时刻或本地入库时刻，需另证）
fields.source:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(CASE WHEN available_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filled
FROM read_parquet('/Users/boos/Desktop/威科夫因子共振趋势/数据/市场数据/parquet/candles/*/*/*/*/*.parquet', union_by_name = true)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(CASE WHEN fetched_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filled
FROM read_parquet('/Users/boos/Desktop/威科夫因子共振趋势/数据/市场数据/parquet/oi/*/*/*/*.parquet', union_by_name = true)

fields.semantic: 冷档 funding 只有 5 列（funding_time/funding_rate/mark_price/rate_type/source），**没有 fetched_at、也没有 exchange/market/symbol** ⇒ 冷档资金费无法自证采集时刻
只有 ts（5m 槽位），没有 fetched_at / published_at ⇒ 无法判断何时可得
K 线可得时间（实测=入库时刻）
fields.source: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(available_at IS NOT NULL) FROM candle_versions
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(fetched_at IS NOT NULL) FROM oi_history
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(fetched_at IS NOT NULL) FROM funding_history
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(fetched_at IS NOT NULL) FROM realtime_quotes

fields.semantic: OI 采集时刻（池内口径）
fields.source: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(fetched_at IS NOT NULL) FROM oi_history WHERE symbol IN (526 币)

available_minus_close_ms.verdict: available_at 与 close_time 的差最小为毫秒级、最大可达数十天 ⇒ 它是**本地入库时刻**，不是交易所发布时刻；不能当 PIT 发布时点用
